messages:
mika.dev: Heads up: community reported our Next edge sample crashes during deploy with "ReferenceError: require is not defined". Looks like consumers/bundlers resolve to the CJS entry in some edge toolchains.

ravi.sdk: Seen this before. Edge runners (Vercel/Deno/Cloudflare) don't provide `require`. If our package exposes a CJS path that some bundler picks, it will blow up at runtime.

claire.docs: Bad onboarding impact: a few folks pasted our quickstart snippets (CommonJS examples) into edge projects and hit the crash. We should switch docs to ESM-first and add a note about edge.

ben.build: Current package.json: top-level "main" -> dist/index.cjs, "module" -> dist/index.mjs, and exports with both import/require. Old bundlers sometimes prefer "main" which causes problems for edge.

lee.eng: Quick mitigation: add a top-level "types" field pointing to dist/index.d.ts so editors pick up types. That fixes the TS UX fast.

mika.dev: Good call. For the runtime issue, can we tweak exports so default/import point to ESM and CJS is only opt-in (e.g., under a "node" condition)? That should reduce incorrect selection by edge packagers.

ravi.sdk: Proposed exports sketch: 
```
"exports": {
  "./package.json": "./package.json",
  ".": {
    "node": { "require": "./dist/index.cjs" },
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "default": "./dist/index.mjs"
  },
  "./types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
}
```
This makes the CJS explicit to Node consumers while keeping ESM as the default.

ben.build: Caution: not all bundlers honor the "node" condition. We'll need to run smoke installs against esbuild/webpack/rollup + Vercel build images. I can add CI jobs for those.

claire.docs: I'll update quickstart to use `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'` and replace any `require()` examples. Also add an "Edge / ESM note" near the top.

lee.eng: Long-term idea: publish ESM-first package and provide a separate legacy CJS package (e.g., @redwood/inference-cjs) as an opt-in package. That avoids complicated exports logic and aligns with edge-first ecosystems. Breaking change but clean.

mika.dev: That would be a major bump; we should RFC it. For now, let's ship minimal low-risk fixes: add top-level "types", change exports as Ravi suggested, update docs + sample, and publish a canary tag.

ben.build: I'll prepare the canary with the exports change and a tiny Node-only CJS shim. Will run build smoke tests against Next edge sample in CI. Canary name: `@redwood/inference@canary-edge-fix-1` (will post full tarball once published).

release-bot: running smoke-tests on branch `canary/edge-fix-1` against Vercel & Cloudflare images. Results will be appended.

mika.dev: Thanks. Claire — please coordinate to flip examples once canary is validated. Ravi/Ben — please add a short note in the CHANGELOG about the exports change and a migration section.

claire.docs: Will do. I'll also add a tiny troubleshooting snippet showing how to detect if your bundler resolved CJS (search for `dist/index.cjs` in your build bundle).

ravi.sdk: One more: add an integration test that `npm pack` the canary, install into the sample, and run `vercel build` in a container. That will catch regressions before publish.

ben.build: Agreed. I'll add pack+vercel-build smoke in the release pipeline. Targeting canary today.
